The '''Officer's Candidate School''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] learning institution on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carida/Legends|Carida]].<ref name="SWE" /> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="Turkana date">The ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'' had [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Xamuel Lennox]] commanding the [[Rebel Dream|''Tyrant'']] during the [[Battle of Turkana/Legends|Battle of Turkana]]. As the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] made use of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] during the battle, it must occur after the Rebels' [[Fresian campaign|campaign]] to obtain the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], which occurred in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] according to ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''. In [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']], the Battle of Turkana occurred at the start of the game, with the end of the second tour of duty focusing on the Alliance obtaining the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]]. Those missions occurred shortly after the [[Battle of Kattada]], which took place in 35:2 GrS&mdash;or 1 BBY&mdash;by its concurrence with the [[Subjugation of Ralltiir]] and that battle's dating in ''[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]''. From this information, it can be determined that the Battle of Turkana occurred in 1 BBY. Because [[Cabbel/Legends|Cabbel]] is depicted as an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] in that game, and {{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Lieutenant Cabbel}} mentioned he was a graduate from the Officer's Candidate School, then he had to have graduated 1 BBY at the latest.</ref> [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] [[Cabbel/Legends|Cabbel]] was a recent graduate of this school.<ref name="CCG-Cabbel">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Lieutenant Cabbel}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Officer's Candidate School was first mentioned in [[1998]], in the Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Cabbel's card for the [[Hoth Limited]] expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG-Cabbel" />
